Introducing Saved Views: a faster way to work. Starting today, you can save any filtered, sorted, or grouped list as a Saved View, so you never have to rebuild your favorite setups from scratch. Whether you track sprint progress, monitor overdue tasks, or organize work by priority, Saved Views keep your exact configuration ready whenever you need it.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no extra cost. Each user can create and store up to 50 Saved Views, giving you plenty of room to build custom perspectives for every project, client, or workflow. Need your teammates to see things the way you do? Any Saved View can be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup, cutting down on repeated questions and duplicated effort.

We built this feature based on your feedback, and we believe it will make managing complex projects noticeably simpler. Give it a try and let us know what you think.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
